what: Evaluate code you do not trust
title: Worked examples
text: common case: application receives R code, web form API, run . eval_safe() runs forked child, policy decides child may . "numeric" preset allows computing nothing else. Ordinary computation works: Reading file outside R’s files fails. Landlock refuses open, R reports warning (reason) error: Warnings raised child stay child, unix::eval_safe(). Catch inside expression see reason: Starting program fails: preset’s seccomp filter refuses execve. opening socket, filter refuses well: loop never ends killed timeout passes, even stuck C code: request memory limit fails inside child, leaving session untouched: enforced report: layer kernel provide reported skipped. acceptable, build policy policy(best_effort = FALSE) evaluation fails instead running less protection.
code: run_untrusted <- function(code, timeout = 5) {   expr <- str2lang(code)   eval_safe(eval(expr), policy = preset("numeric") |> limits(memory = "4g"),             timeout = timeout) } run_untrusted("summary(lm(mpg ~ wt + hp, data = mtcars))$r.squared") #> [1] 0.8267855 run_untrusted("readLines('/etc/passwd', n = 1)") #> Error in `file()`: #> ! cannot open the connection run_untrusted("tryCatch(readLines('/etc/passwd', n = 1), warning = conditionMessage)") #> [1] "cannot open file '/etc/passwd': Permission denied" run_untrusted("tryCatch(system('id', intern = TRUE), error = conditionMessage, warning = conditionMessage)") #> [1] "cannot popen 'id', probable reason 'Operation not permitted'" run_untrusted("tryCatch(serverSocket(18080), error = conditionMessage)") #> [1] "creation of server socket failed: port 18080 cannot be opened" run_untrusted("repeat {}", timeout = 2) #> Error: #> ! timeout reached (2 sec) run_untrusted("x <- numeric(1e9)") #> Error: #> ! cannot allocate vector of size 7.5 Gb last_report() #> <landlock report> Landlock ABI 7  #>   landlock-fs     applied  ABI 7, 15 rules #>   landlock-net    applied  TCP bind: none; connect: none #>   landlock-scope  applied  signal, abstract_unix #>   seccomp         applied  deny 76 calls (errno EPERM); not on this architecture: socketcall; clone() with namespace flags refused #>   caps            applied  bounding set kept (needs CAP_SETPCAP); effective, permitted, inheritable and ambient cleared #>   limits          applied  as=4294967296

title: Worked examples
text: Presets starting point. specific job, list exactly needs. function summarises CSV file input directory writes result output directory; may read input, write output, nothing else user’s. code reach anything else. Writing input directory, reading output just wrote, refused: write read separate rights. file.exists() still answers: Landlock governs opening files, looking metadata.
code: input <- file.path(tempdir(), "input") output <- file.path(tempdir(), "output") dir.create(input) dir.create(output) write.csv(mtcars, file.path(input, "cars.csv"), row.names = FALSE)  task_policy <- policy() |>   fs(read = c(R.home(), .libPaths(), "/usr", input), write = output) |>   net() |>   syscalls(deny = c(preset("dangerous"), preset("no_exec"), preset("no_net"))) |>   caps() |>   limits(memory = "4g", cpu = 30) task_policy #> <landlock policy> best effort  #>   fs read   /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R, /home/runner/work/_temp/Library, /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R/site-library, /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R/library, /usr, /tmp/RtmpEjCM2M/input #>   fs write  /tmp/RtmpEjCM2M/output #>   tcp       bind: none; connect: none #>   limits    as=4 GiB, cpu=30  #>   syscalls  deny 77 calls, action errno  #>   caps      keep none summarise_file <- function(name) {   eval_safe({     d <- read.csv(file.path(input, name))     s <- aggregate(mpg ~ cyl, data = d, FUN = mean)     write.csv(s, file.path(output, "summary.csv"), row.names = FALSE)     nrow(s)   }, policy = task_policy) }  summarise_file("cars.csv") #> [1] 3 read.csv(file.path(output, "summary.csv")) #>   cyl      mpg #> 1   4 26.66364 #> 2   6 19.74286 #> 3   8 15.10000 eval_safe(file.create(file.path(input, "planted.csv")), policy = task_policy) #> [1] FALSE eval_safe(file.exists(file.path(output, "summary.csv")), policy = task_policy) #> [1] TRUE eval_safe(tryCatch(readLines(file.path(output, "summary.csv")), warning = conditionMessage),           policy = task_policy) #> [1] "cannot open file '/tmp/RtmpEjCM2M/output/summary.csv': Permission denied"

title: Getting started with landlock
text: eval_safe() evaluates expression forked child returns value. Errors come back class; output forwarded arrives; timeout wall-clock limit holds even inside C code. Without policy nothing confined: unix::eval_safe(). policy adds kernel layers: denied file access surfaces R warning (“Permission denied”) followed error (“open connection”). Warnings raised child replayed session, unix, catch inside expression need reason.
code: library(landlock)  set.seed(1) eval_safe(mean(rnorm(1e6))) #> [1] 4.690776e-05  tryCatch(eval_safe(stop("not here")), error = conditionMessage) #> [1] "not here"  eval_safe(Sys.sleep(60), timeout = 2) #> Error: timeout reached (2 sec) eval_safe(tryCatch(readLines("/etc/hostname"), warning = conditionMessage),           policy = preset("numeric")) #> [1] "cannot open file '/etc/hostname': Permission denied"

title: Getting started with landlock
text: policy list build verbs: fs() puts filesystem Landlock. Everything listed denied. read, write exec separate rights (write imply read); rw . rule covers path everything . tmp = TRUE adds call’s scratch directory, child’s TMPDIR; session’s tempdir() granted, session may later trust finds . net() restricts TCP bind() connect() listed ports; net() alone blocks . scope() keeps signals abstract Unix sockets inside sandbox. syscalls() denies system calls seccomp filter. caps() drops capabilities sets no_new_privs. limits() sets resource ceilings; ids() switches user (root ); apparmor() changes AppArmor profile. Presets policies start : preset("numeric") code computes, preset("install") installing source package, preset("plumber") serving HTTP. system call sets preset("dangerous"), preset("no_exec") preset("no_net") syscalls().
code: p <- policy() |>   fs(read = c(R.home(), .libPaths(), "/usr"), tmp = TRUE) |>   net() |>   syscalls(deny = c(preset("dangerous"), preset("no_exec"))) |>   caps() |>   limits(memory = "2g", cpu = 60, nofile = 256) p #> <landlock policy> best effort  #>   fs read   /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R, /home/runner/work/_temp/Library, /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R/library, /usr #>   fs tmp    the call's own temporary directory (read and write)   #>   tcp       bind: none; connect: none #>   limits    as=2 GiB, cpu=60, nofile=256  #>   syscalls  deny 63 calls, action errno  #>   caps      keep none

title: The confinement layers
text: Landlock lets unprivileged process restrict . allow-list: fs() policy, every file access covered rule denied EACCES. package always asks kernel handle every right knows, newer kernel never leaves right unmediated. Rights kernel lacks dropped request, report names layer skipped. Landlock cover: reading file metadata (stat()), UDP, Unix sockets bound path (files: fs() covers ), anything already open policy applied, mapping readable file executable memory (mmap(PROT_EXEC), shared libraries load: exec governs starting programs).

title: The confinement layers
text: seccomp filter small program kernel runs every system call. syscalls() builds deny-list: listed calls fail error (kill process), everything else proceeds. Calls made another architecture’s interface, 32-bit calls 64-bit kernel, always refused, since numbers mean different calls. "dangerous" set removes R computation never needs widens kernel’s attack surface: debugging processes, mounting, namespaces, keyrings, bpf, io_uring, kernel modules, leaving process group. Denying unshare also refuses clone() namespace flags, clone3 fails ENOSYS, C library falls back clone(), whose flags filter can inspect. "no_exec" removes execve, program can start. "no_net" removes sockets, also stops UDP DNS. deny-list rather allow-list: R’s system call footprint depends BLAS, packages loaded C library, allow-list tight fails ways hard diagnose.

title: The confinement layers
text: caps() empties capability sets child, process running root keeps uid loses powers. Emptying bounding set, stops anything regaining capability, needs CAP_SETPCAP; unprivileged process nothing lose, report says bounding set kept. no_new_privs stops set-user-id programs file capabilities granting privileges; Landlock seccomp set .

title: The confinement layers
text: limits() sets resource limits (setrlimit()), ceilings: value current hard limit keeps hard limit. memory limits address space, BLAS libraries reserve generously; set OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 give room. ids() switches user group needs root.

title: Build a confinement policy — policy
text: Layers map : fs(): Landlock filesystem rules. Calling puts whole filesystem Landlock: everything listed denied. read allows reading files listing directories, write allows creating, writing, renaming removing (imply read), exec allows executing (reading, loader needs), rw read plus write. Rules apply path everything beneath . Paths must exist policy applied, built. net(): Landlock TCP rules (kernel ABI 4). Calling restricts TCP bind() connect() listed ports; net() alone blocks . UDP Unix sockets affected. scope(): Landlock scopes (ABI 6): signals , abstract Unix socket connections , processes outside sandbox. limits(): resource limits. ceiling: current hard limit already lower kept. memory limits address space (RLIMIT_AS), pids number processes user (RLIMIT_NPROC), cpu CPU seconds, fsize largest file, nofile number open files. Sizes accept numbers bytes strings "512m" "2g". ids(): switch another user group (root ). Applied every layer except resource limits. apparmor(): change AppArmor profile, unix::eval_safe(profile =) . syscalls(): seccomp filter denying listed system calls; see seccomp_deny() actions preset() ready-made sets. Calling syscalls() adds list. caps(): drop every capability except keep set no_new_privs; see caps_drop_all().

title: Build a confinement policy — policy
code: p <- policy() |>   fs(read = c(R.home(), .libPaths()), write = tempdir()) |>   net() |>   limits(memory = "2g", nofile = 256) p #> <landlock policy> best effort  #>   fs read   /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R, /home/runner/work/_temp/Library, /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R/site-library, /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R/library #>   fs write  /tmp/RtmpD89h2w #>   tcp       bind: none; connect: none #>   limits    as=2 GiB, nofile=256

title: Ready-made policies — preset
text: Policies: "numeric": evaluate R code computes. Reads R, installed packages system libraries; reads writes call's temporary directory (child's TMPDIR; see fs()); may execute nothing; TCP; signals abstract sockets scoped sandbox; "dangerous", "no_exec" "no_net" system calls denied; capabilities dropped. "install": install package source. "numeric", plus executing compiler toolchain (dynamic loader, kernel opens execution ) writing lib; "dangerous" calls denied. "plumber": serve HTTP. "numeric", plus binding port; "dangerous" "no_exec" calls denied. System call sets, character vectors syscalls() seccomp_deny(): "dangerous": calls sandboxed R process use widen kernel's attack surface escape sandbox: ptrace, process_vm_readv, mounting, namespaces, keyrings, bpf, perf_event_open, io_uring, userfaultfd, kernel modules, kexec, reboot, swap, clock setting, open_by_handle_at, NUMA policy calls, pidfd_getfd, leaving process group (setsid, setpgid, nothing outlives call), clone3 (see seccomp_deny()), landlock_* seccomp (sandbox complete time filter installed). Never set*id capset, later steps apply_policy() use. "no_exec": execve execveat (system() stops working). "no_net": socket creation use. Also stops DNS, way stop UDP without network namespace. Paths exist system left policies.

code: preset("numeric") #> <landlock policy> best effort  #>   fs read   /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R, /home/runner/work/_temp/Library, /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R/site-library, /opt/R/4.6.1/lib/R/library, /usr, /lib, /lib64, /opt/R, /etc/ld.so.cache, /etc/localtime, /etc/timezone, /etc/os-release, /dev/urandom, /dev/null, /dev/null #>   fs write  /dev/null #>   fs tmp    the call's own temporary directory (read and write)   #>   tcp       bind: none; connect: none #>   scope     signal, abstract_unix   #>   syscalls  deny 77 calls, action errno  #>   caps      keep none

title: Restrict this process with Landlock — restrict_self
text: thin wrapper kernel's Landlock interface calling process: filesystem denied except listed paths, TCP restricted tcp_bind tcp_connect given, scopes applied. Irreversible. Landlock restricts calling thread creates afterwards, threads already exist; see confine().

title: Restrict this process with Landlock — restrict_self
code: # Irreversible, so shown in a throwaway child. Where Landlock is # available, everything outside R's own files becomes unreadable. eval_fork({   restrict_self(read = c(R.home(), .libPaths()))   tryCatch(readLines("/etc/passwd", n = 1), warning = conditionMessage) }) #> [1] "cannot open file '/etc/passwd': Permission denied"

text: resource soft limit (cur), kernel enforces, hard limit (max), ceiling soft limit. unprivileged process may set soft limit anywhere hard limit may lower hard limit, irreversibly. Setting cur current max also tries raise max, privileged process may . : maximum size virtual address space, bytes. core: maximum size core dump. cpu: CPU time seconds; process receives SIGXCPU soft limit. data: maximum size data segment. fsize: largest file process may create. memlock: bytes memory may locked RAM. nofile: one largest file descriptor number. nproc: processes real user id; enforced root. stack: maximum stack size.

title: System call filters — seccomp_deny
text: seccomp_deny() installs seccomp-bpf filter calling process makes listed system calls fail (kills process) allows every call. Filters stack removed; also sets no_new_privs. Calls made another architecture's ABI (32-bit calls 64-bit kernel) always refused. Linux .

title: System call filters — seccomp_deny
code: seccomp_deny(   syscalls,   action = c("errno", "kill", "log", "trap"),   errno = "EPERM" )  seccomp_status()  syscall_table()

title: System call filters — seccomp_deny
text: syscalls Character vector system call names. Names exist architectures ignored. action happens denied call; see Details. errno Error returned action = "errno": name "EPERM" "EACCES", number.

title: System call filters — seccomp_deny
text: seccomp_deny(): TRUE every thread got filter, FALSE calling one, invisibly. seccomp_status(): list mode (0 none, 1 strict, 2 filter) number filters. syscall_table(): data frame name nr.

title: System call filters — seccomp_deny
text: filter goes every thread process kernel can (seccomp's TSYNC flag), otherwise calling thread. Two calls get special treatment. clone3 always fails ENOSYS, C library falls back clone(), whose flags filter can inspect. Denying unshare also refuses clone() namespace flag, otherwise create namespaces. Actions: "errno" makes call fail errno (default EPERM), "kill" kills process SIGSYS, "log" allows call logs kernel audit log, "trap" sends SIGSYS thread. syscall_table() lists system calls build knows architecture; preset() provides sets "dangerous", "no_exec" "no_net". seccomp_status() reports filter state process.

title: System call filters — seccomp_deny
code: seccomp_status() #> $mode #> [1] 0 #>  #> $filters #> [1] 0 #>  head(syscall_table()) #>      name  nr #> 1    read   0 #> 2   write   1 #> 3    open   2 #> 4  openat 257 #> 5 openat2 437 #> 6   close   3  # Irreversible, so shown in a throwaway child; Linux only. if (Sys.info()[["sysname"]] == "Linux") {   eval_fork({     seccomp_deny("getppid")     getppid()  # -1: the call failed with EPERM   }) } #> [1] -1

title: landlock 0.1.0
text: First release. drop-replacement ‘unix’ package: 32 exports, names, arguments results (eval_safe(), eval_fork(), rlimit_*() family, process id functions, user_info(), group_info(), chroot(), sys_config(), aa_config()). eval_safe(profile =) changes AppArmor profile /proc, without ‘libapparmor’. eval_safe() gains policy argument; run() executes program one; confine() applies one session. Policies built policy(), fs(), net(), scope(), syscalls(), caps(), limits(), ids() apparmor(), started preset("numeric"), preset("install") preset("plumber"). Layers: Landlock filesystem rules, TCP port rules (kernel ABI 4) scopes (ABI 6); seccomp-bpf system call filter, sets "dangerous", "no_exec" "no_net"; capability dropping no_new_privs; resource limits user switching. layer kernel provide skipped reported (last_report()); policy(best_effort = FALSE) makes error. status() shows running kernel offers. Single-layer functions calling process: restrict_self(), seccomp_deny(), caps_drop_all(), caps_keep(), no_new_privs(), setids().
